newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FAI sets A$240 mln mortgage-backed issue.
newsitem.headline: FAI sets A$240 mln mortgage-backed issue.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd said on Thursday its wholly-owned subsidiary FAI Homes Loans has announced an issue of a further A$240 million in mortgage-backed securities through the Residential Mortgage Trust (RMT).
FAI said this second issue, which took the total securities under this programme to A$440 million, was necessary due to significant growth in home lending.
The issue, which has provision for borrower redraw, split and fixing options, took place today and was fully subscribed.
It was structured and arranged by Westpac Banking Corp .
